<thought>Based on the observed M+1 peak (~12 % of the base) indicating the presence of 13C, carbon can be confirmed. The relatively strong M+2 peak (~33 % of the base) is characteristic of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl isotopic pattern), allowing chlorine to be identified as well. No other element shows a definitive isotopic pattern in the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
